about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm a frontend developer based in Pavia, Italy. I started out building interfaces on legacy stacks for banks and insurance companies, and for the past few years I've been maintaining and developing DeAgostini Publishing's public-facing websites, gradually weaving AI-assisted development tools into my workflow. I like code that ages well: readable today, easy to update three years from now.

entries.text: ownership of the maintenance and frontend development of the company's two public-facing websites.
AI-assisted development workflow (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to speed up the release cycle.
Docker for the local development environment.
AWS and Heroku cloud services for deployment.
continuous updates of the project's libraries and frameworks.
end-to-end user experience, from brief to production deploy.
